extras: Plugin is in beta and requires the Git plugin. Performance may degrade with many versions.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that utilizes Git commit history to display dynamic changelogs in your sidebar.
problem: Users need a way to easily track changes in their vault history to detect potential data loss or unintended modifications.

relations.evidence: Requires the Git plugin to be installed.
You can create an action (macro) using the QuickAdd plugin
rely on the File Recovery plugin
Use the Version History Diff plugin for easier navigation through those versions.

summary: A plugin that utilizes Git commit history to display dynamic vault and file changelogs in the sidebar, serving as a data loss monitoring tool.
